annotations.title: Wait until a condition is met

description: Long-poll until a condition is met (or timeout). Replaces polling loops. Conditions: process_ended, process_started, file_stable (render/download done), file_exists, window_title_contains. Max 50s per call; if satisfied=false, call again to keep waiting.

file_stable.description: File path that must stop growing

process_ended.description: Process name fragment that must exit

process_started.description: Process name fragment that must start

window_title_contains.description: Window title fragment that must appear

name: wait_for
